title: Video Downloader HD - Vidow
summary: Watch and save videos for offline viewing and cast videos to TV
description:
Easy Video Downloader 

Download videos and watch them offline anytime. The HD video saver app allows you to save publicly accessible videos for personal use and manage them easily in one place. You can also cast downloaded videos to your TV. The Video Downloader HD - Vidow app supports common video formats such as MP4, M4V, MOV, and more. You can choose the resolution before downloading. Also, multiple videos can be downloaded at the same time. Background downloading is fully supported for convenience.

 Organize Downloaded Files 

Pause, resume, or retry downloads anytime. Easily rename, delete, or share your downloaded videos. The app also keeps track of completed and in-progress downloads for easy management.

 Built-in Video Player 

Watch your videos offline directly in the HD video downloader app without needing any other player. The built-in video player supports smooth HD playback and helps you manage your saved videos easily. 

 Cast Videos to TV 

Enjoy your saved videos on a bigger screen by casting them to smart TVs. This feature allows seamless playback between your smartphone and TV for a better viewing experience.

 Key Features of Video Downloader HD - Vidow 
✦ Download videos for offline viewing
✦ Save, watch, and share videos easily
✦ Video player for smooth offline playback
✦ Cast downloaded videos to smart TVs
✦ Supports common formats (MP4, M4V, MOV, etc.)
✦ Pause, resume, delete, rename, or share downloads
✦ Background downloading supported
✦ Easy track of completed and in-progress downloads

 How it Works 
● Copy the video link
● Open the Video Downloader HD - Vidow app
● Choose your preferred format to save video
● Click download and enjoy offline playback anytime.
